title: Systems Experiments Statistical Design and Estimands Specification for E09 (Concurrency) and E10 (Full-Stack HTTP)

global_parameters.target_database_backend: PostgreSQL 16.14 under READ COMMITTED with 7-Class Lock Hierarchy & Serializable OCC Revalidation
global_parameters.isolation_guarantee: Strict benchmark harness isolation; all connections drawn from dedicated pool with connection pooling bypass and instrumentation hooks.

E09.title: Real PostgreSQL Concurrency & Contention Analysis
primary_research_questions: How does entity-partitioned DAG versioning scale in commit throughput (TPS) and tail latency (p50, p95, p99 ms) under worker concurrency W in {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64}?
Does entity-partitioned DAG versioning strictly preserve a 0.0% false-stale abort rate under 100% disjoint concurrent write workloads?
Does the 7-class governance lock hierarchy guarantee 0 deadlocks across all 10 clinical workload contention regimes?

WF01_same_entity_contention.name: Same-Entity Contention (Hotspot Collisions)
WF01_same_entity_contention.description: All W concurrent workers attempt to commit mutations targeting the exact same patient entity partition coordinate (100% write conflict).
WF01_same_entity_contention.expected_abort_behavior: True-stale aborts dominate; exactly 1 winner advances CAS version, W-1 aborted with stale_entity_partition. 0 false-stale aborts.

WF02_disjoint_entity.name: Disjoint Entity Partitions (Pure Parallelism)
WF02_disjoint_entity.description: Each of the W workers mutates an independent, mutually disjoint entity partition coordinate within or across patient profiles.
WF02_disjoint_entity.access_pattern: W disjoint entity keys (e.g., phr_1001:medication:med_rx_{worker_id}), 100% writes.
WF02_disjoint_entity.expected_abort_behavior: 0 true-stale aborts, 0 false-stale aborts (target 0.0%), 0 deadlocks. Linear scaling expected up to connection/IO saturation.

WF03_partial_overlap_25.name: Partial Partition Overlap (25% Cross-Contention)
WF03_partial_overlap_25.description: 25% of submitted write transactions contend on shared entity partitions, while 75% target disjoint partitions.
WF03_partial_overlap_25.access_pattern: Bernoulli(p=0.25) collision on shared entity key; (1-p)=0.75 on disjoint keys.
WF03_partial_overlap_25.expected_abort_behavior: Controlled true-stale aborts proportional to overlap; false-stale abort rate strictly 0.0% on unshared partitions.

WF04_multi_domain.name: Multi-Domain Atomic Bundle Transactions
WF04_multi_domain.description: Each transaction spans multiple clinical domains (medication, condition, observation, allergy_intolerance) within a single atomic commit.
WF04_multi_domain.access_pattern: 4 partition coordinates per transaction acquired in strict lexicographical order: (domain ASC, semantic_key ASC).
WF04_multi_domain.theoretical_winner_count_per_round: Variable based on domain partition interleaving
WF04_multi_domain.expected_abort_behavior: Zero deadlocks despite multi-key multi-domain lock acquisition; verification of Class 5 total order sorting.

WF05_hot_key_zipfian.name: Hot-Key Contention under Zipfian Distribution
WF05_hot_key_zipfian.description: Workers select entity partitions following a Zipfian distribution with skew parameter theta = 1.4 across a pool of K=100 entity partitions.
WF05_hot_key_zipfian.theoretical_winner_count_per_round: Sub-linear; heavy contention on top 5% hot-keys.
WF05_hot_key_zipfian.expected_abort_behavior: Stress tests lock queuing under extreme realistic skew; evaluates p95/p99 tail latency inflation.

WF06_governance_entity_race.name: Concurrent Governance Policy Advance + Entity Writes
WF06_governance_entity_race.description: Background workers advance domain policy epochs (Class 2 exclusive lock) while foreground workers commit clinical entity transitions.
WF06_governance_entity_race.access_pattern: 10% Class 2 policy updates, 90% Class 5 entity writes.
WF06_governance_entity_race.theoretical_winner_count_per_round: Pre-epoch commits succeed; post-epoch commits safely abort with stale_policy_version.
WF06_governance_entity_race.expected_abort_behavior: Zero phantom writes; atomic invalidation of in-flight proposals across entire domain.

WF07_evidence_entity_race.name: Concurrent Evidence Invalidation + Entity Writes
WF07_evidence_entity_race.description: Background workers invalidate or revoke clinical evidence items (Class 4 advisory lock) while foreground transactions assert those evidence IDs.
WF07_evidence_entity_race.access_pattern: 10% Class 4 evidence revocations, 90% Class 5 entity writes with asserted evidence dependencies.
WF07_evidence_entity_race.theoretical_winner_count_per_round: Transactions committing after evidence revocation fail with evidence_undisclosed or evidence_revoked.
WF07_evidence_entity_race.expected_abort_behavior: Zero TOCTOU leaks on invalid evidence; strict fail-closed assertion.

WF08_read_heavy_90_10.name: Read-Heavy Clinical Workload (90% Read / 10% Write)
WF08_read_heavy_90_10.description: Simulates typical EHR clinical consultation workflows where 90% of requests are state reads/validations and 10% are commitment transitions.
WF08_read_heavy_90_10.access_pattern: 90% Class 5 FOR SHARE / snapshot reads, 10% Class 5 FOR UPDATE mutations.
WF08_read_heavy_90_10.expected_abort_behavior: High throughput; minimal aborts due to shared-lock concurrency.

WF09_write_heavy_10_90.name: Write-Heavy Intensive Ingestion (10% Read / 90% Write)
WF09_write_heavy_10_90.description: Simulates high-throughput automated agent batch processing and clinical event ingestion streams.
WF09_write_heavy_10_90.access_pattern: 10% reads, 90% Class 5 FOR UPDATE mutations across partition pool.
WF09_write_heavy_10_90.expected_abort_behavior: Evaluates database WAL throughput, connection lock saturation, and CAS retry overhead.

WF10_mixed_50_50.name: Balanced Mixed Workload (50% Read / 50% Write)
WF10_mixed_50_50.description: Standard benchmark baseline balancing state validation/reconstruction and active commitment state progression.
WF10_mixed_50_50.access_pattern: 50% reads, 50% writes across uniform random entity partition selections.

primary.name: Commit Throughput (TPS)
primary.definition: Total committed transactions divided by total elapsed wall-clock execution time in seconds across worker grid W.
primary.aggregation: Mean, standard deviation, and 95% bootstrap confidence interval across R >= 5 independent runs per cell.
primary.target: Monotonic throughput scaling from W=1 to W=8 on disjoint workloads (WF02, WF08).

primary.name: Latency Distribution (p50, p95, p99 ms)
primary.definition: Empirical quantiles (50th, 95th, 99th percentiles) of end-to-end transaction commit execution latency in milliseconds.
primary.formula: Q_p(L) = inf { l in R : F_n(l) >= p } where F_n is the empirical CDF of observed latencies.
primary.aggregation: Nearest-rank quantile with Harrell-Davis bootstrap standard error estimation.

secondary.name: True-Stale Abort Rate
secondary.definition: Proportion of transaction attempts aborted due to genuine CAS version progression on their declared write dependency partitions.
secondary.aggregation: Sample proportion with 95% Wilson score confidence interval.
secondary.target: Matches theoretical collision expectation (1.0 - 1/W for WF01).

secondary.name: False-Stale Abort Rate
secondary.definition: Proportion of transaction attempts aborted due to version advances on independent, unrelated entity partitions.
secondary.aggregation: Sample proportion with 1-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% Upper Confidence Bound (UCB).
secondary.target: 0.0000 (Exact 0.0% on disjoint partition workloads WF02, proving zero partition interference).

secondary.name: Deadlock Count
secondary.definition: Total occurrences of PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 40P01 (deadlock_detected) during lock acquisition across all runs.
secondary.aggregation: Cumulative sum across all 70 grid cells.
secondary.target: 0 (Zero tolerance; any deadlock is a critical safety failure halting benchmark).

secondary.name: Advisory Lock Wait Latency (ms)
secondary.definition: Time spent blocked waiting for Class 1..7 advisory and row locks during Phase 2 of the commit kernel.
secondary.aggregation: Mean, p95, and max wait time per concurrency cell.

statistical_methods.throughput_modeling: Generalized Additive Model (GAM) with spline basis on log2(W) to characterize scalability frontiers and contention saturation knees.
statistical_methods.false_stale_zero_proof: 1-sided Clopper-Pearson exact binomial confidence upper bound: UCB_95 = 1 - (1 - 0.95)^(1/N) for 0 observed false-stale aborts.
statistical_methods.quantile_estimation: Harrell-Davis distribution-free quantile estimator for p50, p95, p99.

fail_closed_criteria: Any deadlock (SQLSTATE 40P01) observed in any cell halts the experiment immediately.
Any false-stale abort (> 0) on disjoint entity workload (WF02) fails invariant I01 and halts the experiment.
Any CAS non-monotonic version progression fails invariant I06 and invalidates the run.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Thread crashes or network drops are recorded as OPERATIONAL_FAILURE; missing runs must be re-executed under identical seed parameters.

E10.title: HTTP / PostgreSQL Full-Stack Performance Characterization
primary_research_questions: What is the end-to-end wall-clock latency (p50, p95, p99 ms) and throughput (TPS) for all 7 production HTTP REST gateway operations under real PostgreSQL 16.14 persistence?
What is the exact database query overhead (SQL read statements vs SQL write statements) per REST operation class?
What is the Write Amplification Factor (WAF) and server memory RSS / CPU time footprint incurred by full GRWC validation?

OP01_transition.name: State Commitment Transition
OP01_transition.description: Full 6-phase atomic commit kernel executing idempotency check, 7-class lock acquisition, GRWC admission validation, domain mutation callback, CAS version bump, and applied transition persistence.

OP02_reconstruction.name: State DAG Reconstruction
OP02_reconstruction.description: Deterministic historical state reconstruction by traversing the immutable applied transition ledger and partition version links from genesis to requested target version.

OP03_snapshot_compile.name: THSS Snapshot Compilation
OP03_snapshot_compile.description: Compiles task-minimized health state projection, computes RFC 8785 canonical JSON projection digest and manifest digest, and persists immutable snapshot record.

OP04_governed_decision_reconstruction.name: Governed Decision Trail Reconstruction
OP04_governed_decision_reconstruction.description: Audits complete provenance trail connecting model proposal lineage, inference context binding, THSS snapshot disclosure, policy/consent epochs, and applied commit record.

OP05_audit_lookup.name: Audit Ledger Verification Lookup
OP05_audit_lookup.description: Cryptographic integrity lookup on applied transition records, validating request/result/disclosure digests against database ledger.

OP06_invalidation_rebuild.name: Partition DAG Invalidation Rebuild
OP06_invalidation_rebuild.description: Explicit cache invalidation and DAG branch recalculation following out-of-band policy/consent revocation or upstream clinical synchronization.

OP07_enter_in_error_rebuild.name: Enter-in-Error State Rebuild
OP07_enter_in_error_rebuild.description: Retrospective clinical correction marking a historical transition as entered-in-error, performing compensating state DAG branch rebuild while preserving audit trail.

primary.name: End-to-End HTTP Wall-Clock Latency (p50, p95, p99 ms)
primary.definition: Elapsed wall-clock time from HTTP request dispatch over TCP socket to complete HTTP response body reception and parsing.
primary.aggregation: Empirical quantiles p50, p95, p99 with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals per operation class (N=100 each).

primary.name: Per-Operation HTTP Throughput (TPS)
primary.definition: Sustained requests completed per second under single-client persistent HTTP/1.1 connection pipeline.
primary.aggregation: Mean TPS across 100 repetitions per class.

secondary.name: SQL Statement Statement Count Profile (Read / Write)
secondary.definition: Exact count of SQL queries dispatched to PostgreSQL per HTTP request, decomposed into SELECT queries (reads) and INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE queries (writes).
secondary.formula: N_sql_read = Count(SELECT), N_sql_write = Count(INSERT + UPDATE + DELETE)
secondary.aggregation: Mean, min, max per operation class (verified via SQLAlchemy event instrumentation listeners).

secondary.name: Write Amplification Factor (WAF)
secondary.definition: Ratio of total bytes written to PostgreSQL disk/WAL tables to the logical semantic payload mutation bytes.
secondary.aggregation: Mean and p95 across write-bearing operation classes (OP01, OP03, OP06, OP07).
secondary.target: WAF < 3.5 (governance audit and partition versioning overhead bounded).

secondary.name: Server Resource Footprint (Memory RSS & CPU Time)
secondary.definition: Resident Set Size (RSS) delta in megabytes (MB) and total process CPU time (user + system) in milliseconds consumed per request cycle.
secondary.formula: Delta_RSS = RSS_post - RSS_pre (MB); CPU_time = Delta(t_user + t_system) (ms)
secondary.aggregation: Mean and peak RSS growth across the 700-request benchmark suite.

statistical_methods.latency_quantiles: Nearest-rank and Harrell-Davis estimation with 10,000 bootstrap resamples for 95% BCa confidence intervals.
statistical_methods.anova_and_kruskal_wallis: Non-parametric Kruskal-Wallis test across the 7 operation classes to evaluate between-class latency heterogeneity (H-statistic and p-value).
statistical_methods.correlation_analysis: Spearman rank correlation between SQL statement count and end-to-end HTTP latency.

fail_closed_criteria: HTTP status code 500 error rate exceeding 0.001 (0.1%) halts the benchmark.
Any response payload hash mismatch or invariant failure invalidates the benchmark trial.
Memory leak rate exceeding 1.0 MB per 100 requests triggers investigation and halts sealing.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Dropped requests due to network reset are recorded as CONNECTION_ERROR and retried up to 1 time with retry count logged.

cross_experiment_synthesis.systems_characterization_scope: E09 characterizes concurrency limits, lock queuing, and partition isolation scaling in PostgreSQL, while E10 characterizes full-stack REST API gateway processing overhead, serialization, and network round-trip overhead.
cross_experiment_synthesis.joint_capacity_model: Combines E09 kernel TPS scaling with E10 HTTP per-operation latency to establish deployment service level objectives (SLOs) for clinical AI deployments.

reproducibility_and_sealing.checksum_rule: Every raw run ledger (runs.jsonl / benchmark_raw.json), derived statistical summary (summary.json), and report (summary.md) must have its SHA-256 registered in checksums.sha256 and seal.json.
